name: Yiedl vault forwards caller-supplied 1inch calldata
summary: The Yiedl vault's redeem path forwards caller-supplied 1inch unoswapTo calldata without validating the swap recipient, so the attacker set itself as the destination and drained the vault's USDC, BTCB and BETH.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/yiedl.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.

sources.note: onchain review: victim 0x4eDda16AB4f4cc46b160aBC42763BA63885862a4 created 2024-04-23T07:57:48Z by 0xc0aacf2a87bbdfff6e582762a7c4259ead5aee30, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x322696471792440499b1979e0a440491e870667a; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). Loss measured from the exploit transaction: the vault loses 75,635.14 USDC, 0.5214 BTCB and 8.3338 BETH, roughly USD 135K in total.
